units.title: Verify: Manifest file validity and scene coverage unit tests

tests.name: the-boys-room manifest.json parses through parseManifest
tests.title: the-boys-room manifest.json parses through parseManifest without errors
tests.scenario: Given the real manifest.json, When validated with parseManifest, Then result.ok is true

tests.name: every manifest asset path exists on disk
tests.title: points every asset path at a file that exists on disk
tests.scenario: Given the real manifest and public assets root, When each asset path is resolved, Then no path is missing

tests.name: every bedroom.yaml asset ref has a manifest id
tests.title: gives every asset ref in bedroom.yaml a matching manifest id
tests.scenario: Given manifest ids and bedroom.yaml objects, When asset refs are collected, Then refs are non-empty and each is a manifest id

tests.name: character:boy is a 2-frame spritesheet with idle
tests.title: describes character:boy as a 2-frame spritesheet with an idle animation
tests.scenario: Given the character:boy entry, When frames and animations are inspected, Then frameCount is 2 and animations.idle exists

units.title: Verify: Manifest loader missing-file and malformed-input unit tests

tests.name: loadManifestFile > reports the asset path as an error when the referenced file is missing
tests.title: loadManifestFile reports the asset path as an error when the referenced file is missing
tests.scenario: Given a valid manifest whose a.svg is absent, When loaded, Then ok:false with path assets.0.path

tests.name: loadManifestFile > loads successfully once the referenced asset file exists
tests.title: loadManifestFile loads successfully once the referenced asset file exists
tests.scenario: Given a valid manifest and a.svg present, When loaded, Then ok:true with parsed assets

tests.name: loadManifestFile > reports the manifest itself as unreadable when the manifest file does not exist
tests.title: loadManifestFile reports the manifest itself as unreadable when the manifest file does not exist
tests.scenario: Given a nonexistent manifest path, When loaded, Then ok:false with path manifest and no throw

tests.name: loadManifestFile > reports the manifest itself as unreadable when the manifest file is not valid JSON
tests.title: loadManifestFile reports the manifest itself as unreadable when the manifest file is not valid JSON
tests.scenario: Given a manifest file containing 'not json', When loaded, Then ok:false with path manifest and no throw
